business_summary: Tohoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated operates as an energy service in Japan and internationally. It generates and supplies electricity through hydroelectric, thermal, wind, solar, nuclear power stations. Tohoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Tohoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated는 일본 및 국제적으로 에너지 서비스 업체로 운영되고 있습니다. 수력, 화력, 풍력, 태양광, 원자력 발전소를 통해 전기를 생산하고 공급합니다. Tohoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated는 1951년에 설립되었으며 일본 센다이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
